title: An AI assistant for founders that lives on your Mac
metaTitle: AI assistant for founders on Mac: replies, research
description: An AI assistant for founders on Mac: hold a key to draft the investor reply, research competitors in the background and book the meeting, without leaving the app you are in.
intro: Lazur is an AI assistant for founders that sits in your Mac's notch. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and it drafts the reply on screen, books the call, or runs competitor research in the background while you keep working.
tldr: Draft replies from the email on screen: “reply, yes to Tuesday, send the deck after”.
Hand off research: “research our top 5 competitors' pricing” runs in the background.
Calendar, reminders and timers by voice, without opening another app.

painPoints.title: Inbox and Slack eat the morning
painPoints.text: Most replies are three sentences you already know. Saying them is faster than typing them.

painPoints.title: Research gets pushed to tonight
painPoints.text: Competitor pricing, a market size, a list of investors. Small jobs that take an hour of tabs.

painPoints.title: Context switching
painPoints.text: Every switch to a chat window means copying, pasting and explaining what you are looking at.

blocks.text: What a founder's day with Lazur looks like

You stay in the app you are in. Lazur sees it, so you never explain what you are looking at. Short things happen right away. Long things, like research, run in the background and come back as a report.

faq.question: Can Lazur send emails for me?
faq.answer: It writes the draft at your cursor. You read it and send it.

faq.question: Does Lazur work in every app?
faq.answer: Yes. It works on top of any Mac app: Mail, Slack, Chrome, Word, Figma, Cursor and the rest.

faq.question: Is it always listening?
faq.answer: No. It listens and looks at your screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot are not stored.
